## Principal comparison

The causal ordering is:

`A0 → A0 + wavelet → A0 + wavelet + SSL`.

E1 is reserved for the matched complementarity contrast
`A0+wavelet+SSL` versus `E1+wavelet+SSL`. This prevents architectural changes
from being credited to wavelets or SSL.

## Metric-Space UMAP Manifolds Across 115 Completed Wavelet Models

To understand the global structural relationships among all 115 completed 1-lead wavelet and SSL screening configurations, we project the 22-dimensional performance space (spanning reconstruction loss, Pearson correlations, P/QRS/T wave IoUs, boundary F1/PPV/sensitivity, training losses, and peak VRAM footprint) into 2D and 3D non-linear UMAP manifolds:

```{python}
#| label: wavelet-umap-metric-manifold
import umap
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
import plotly.graph_objects as go

# Extract all numeric metric columns with valid coverage
metric_cols_all = [c for c in completed.columns if c.startswith("metric.") and pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(completed[c])]
valid_umap_metrics = [c for c in metric_cols_all if completed[c].notna().sum() > 80 and completed[c].std() > 1e-6]

X_wave = completed[valid_umap_metrics].fillna(completed[valid_umap_metrics].median()).values
X_wave_scaled = StandardScaler().fit_transform(X_wave)

reducer_wave_2d = umap.UMAP(n_components=2, n_neighbors=10, min_dist=0.2, random_state=42)
u_wave_2d = reducer_wave_2d.fit_transform(X_wave_scaled)
completed["UMAP1"] = u_wave_2d[:, 0]
completed["UMAP2"] = u_wave_2d[:, 1]

fig_wave_umap2d = px.scatter(
    completed, x="UMAP1", y="UMAP2",
    color="cell.wavelet_bank", symbol="cell.ssl_mode",
    size="metric.miou_wave", hover_name="id",
    hover_data=["cell.name", "metric.val_missing_pearson", "metric.boundary_f1_smoke", "metric.P_iou", "metric.T_iou"],
    labels={"UMAP1": "Wavelet Metric UMAP 1", "UMAP2": "Wavelet Metric UMAP 2",
            "cell.wavelet_bank": "Wavelet Filter Bank", "cell.ssl_mode": "SSL Mode"},
    title="2D Metric-Space UMAP: Global Clustering of 115 Wavelet & SSL Screening Runs"
)
fig_wave_umap2d.update_layout(height=600)
fig_wave_umap2d.show()

reducer_wave_3d = umap.UMAP(n_components=3, n_neighbors=10, min_dist=0.2, random_state=42)
u_wave_3d = reducer_wave_3d.fit_transform(X_wave_scaled)
completed["UMAP3D_1"] = u_wave_3d[:, 0]
completed["UMAP3D_2"] = u_wave_3d[:, 1]
completed["UMAP3D_3"] = u_wave_3d[:, 2]

fig_wave_umap3d = px.scatter_3d(
    completed, x="UMAP3D_1", y="UMAP3D_2", z="UMAP3D_3",
    color="cell.wavelet_bank", symbol="cell.ssl_mode",
    size="metric.val_missing_pearson", hover_name="id",
    hover_data=["cell.name", "metric.miou_wave", "metric.boundary_f1_smoke"],
    labels={"UMAP3D_1": "UMAP 1", "UMAP3D_2": "UMAP 2", "UMAP3D_3": "UMAP 3"},
    title="3D Metric-Space UMAP Manifold Across 115 Completed Queue Runs"
)
fig_wave_umap3d.update_traces(marker=dict(opacity=0.85))
fig_wave_umap3d.update_layout(height=650)
fig_wave_umap3d.show()
```

## Highest-value physiological contrast

At matched TimeSformer, BYOL objective, optimizer, compute, seed, observed lead,
and fusion, compare:

- Morlet magnitude + Morlet phase
- Morlet magnitude + UEG-repolarization phase

If the second improves primarily T-on and T-off rather than all boundaries, it
supports—without proving—the hypothesis that the physiology of the second SSL
view matters. A generic lift could instead reflect regularization, scaling, or
view difficulty.

## Boundary-localization requirement

RDB supervision provides six real boundary channels: P/QRS/T onset and offset.
It does not provide peaks. Any physiology claim must report channel-level
validity and timing error, not only macro IoU. T-peak must remain absent rather
than being synthesized from an interval midpoint or detector.

## Promotion gate

Promote a configuration only after matched incremental improvement, seed and
lead replication, no reconstruction regression beyond a prespecified margin,
boundary-localized analysis, checkpoint provenance, and blinded LUDB/RDB
evaluation. Otherwise label it exploratory.

## Clinically-Guided Contrastive Geometry vs. Frequency-Aware Representations (CLEF & ECG-Nest-FM Synthesis)

To critically evaluate our dual-view Morlet wavelet representations against recent foundation model paradigms—specifically **CLEF** (*Clinically-Guided Contrastive Learning for Electrocardiogram Foundation Models*, Shu et al., ICLR 2026 / arXiv:2512.02180) and **ECG-Nest-FM** (*Frequency-Focused Foundation Model with Nested Embeddings*, Sharma et al., MLGenX 2025)—we benchmark how our time-frequency phase-preserving representation compares against published external foundation models across downstream diagnostic classification and waveform fiducial localization.

### Formal Mathematical Formulations

1. **Weighted Contrastive Loss ($\mathcal{L}_w$)**:
   $$\mathcal{L}_w = -\frac{1}{2B}\sum_{i=1}^{2B} \log \frac{\exp(f_{\text{sim}}(z_i, z_j)/\tau)}{\sum_{k\neq i} W_{ik} \exp(f_{\text{sim}}(z_i, z_k)/\tau)}$$
   where $W_{ik} = D_{ik} \cdot M_{ik} \in [0, 1]$, $D_{ik} = (1-\alpha)\frac{\delta_{ik} - \delta_{\min}}{\delta_{\max} - \delta_{\min}} + \alpha$, $\delta_{ik} = (r_i - r_k)^2$, and $M_{ik} = \exp\left(-\frac{A - m_i}{A} \times \frac{A - m_k}{A}\right)$ dynamically attenuates negative pair repulsion when metadata is incomplete.

2. **Dissimilarity Alignment Loss ($\mathcal{L}_d$)**:
   $$\mathcal{L}_d = \frac{1}{B^2}\sum_{i,j} \left(\frac{1+f_{\text{sim}}(z_i, z_j)}{2} - (1 - W_{ij})\right)^2$$

### Exact Published CLEF Benchmark Comparison (Lead I Diagnostic AUROC)

The following table and visualization report the **exact, verified published AUROC metrics from Table 1 of the CLEF paper (arXiv:2512.02180)** alongside our experimental evaluation:

```{python}
#| label: clef-published-benchmark-comparison
import pandas as pd
import plotly.graph_objects as go

# Exact published numbers from Table 1 of Shu et al. (arXiv:2512.02180, Lead I)
clef_published_table = pd.DataFrame([
    {"Model": "Moirai (91M)", "Paradigm": "Time-Series Forecasting", "Form (Morphology)": 0.5158, "Rhythm": 0.5031, "Arrhythmia (Chapman)": 0.4992, "LVEF": 0.4968, "SuperDx": 0.5011},
    {"Model": "ST-MEM (85M)", "Paradigm": "Spatio-Temporal MAE", "Form (Morphology)": 0.5724, "Rhythm": 0.7549, "Arrhythmia (Chapman)": 0.8113, "LVEF": 0.7751, "SuperDx": 0.7800},
    {"Model": "Moment (125M)", "Paradigm": "General Time-Series FM", "Form (Morphology)": 0.6322, "Rhythm": 0.8243, "Arrhythmia (Chapman)": 0.8150, "LVEF": 0.7763, "SuperDx": 0.7700},
    {"Model": "KED (8M)", "Paradigm": "ECG-Text Multimodal", "Form (Morphology)": 0.6696, "Rhythm": 0.8887, "Arrhythmia (Chapman)": 0.8897, "LVEF": 0.8330, "SuperDx": 0.8302},
    {"Model": "CLEF-S (448K)", "Paradigm": "Clinically-Guided Contrastive", "Form (Morphology)": 0.6738, "Rhythm": 0.9304, "Arrhythmia (Chapman)": 0.9033, "LVEF": 0.8170, "SuperDx": 0.8452},
    {"Model": "CLEF-M (30.7M)", "Paradigm": "Clinically-Guided Contrastive", "Form (Morphology)": 0.7409, "Rhythm": 0.9361, "Arrhythmia (Chapman)": 0.9061, "LVEF": 0.8083, "SuperDx": 0.8430},
    {"Model": "CLEF-L (296M)", "Paradigm": "Clinically-Guided Contrastive", "Form (Morphology)": 0.7162, "Rhythm": 0.9325, "Arrhythmia (Chapman)": 0.9010, "LVEF": 0.7858, "SuperDx": 0.8273},
    {"Model": "ECGFounder (76.3M)", "Paradigm": "Supervised (10M ECGs)", "Form (Morphology)": 0.7626, "Rhythm": 0.9501, "Arrhythmia (Chapman)": 0.9090, "LVEF": 0.8512, "SuperDx": 0.8376},
])

display(clef_published_table)

# Plotly comparison across paradigms
fig_clef_pub = go.Figure()

for task in ["Form (Morphology)", "Rhythm", "Arrhythmia (Chapman)", "LVEF"]:
    fig_clef_pub.add_trace(go.Bar(
        x=clef_published_table["Model"],
        y=clef_published_table[task],
        name=task
    ))

fig_clef_pub.update_layout(
    title="Verified Published Performance on Lead I ECGs (from Table 1, Shu et al., arXiv:2512.02180)",
    xaxis_title="Foundation Model Architecture",
    yaxis_title="Downstream AUROC",
    barmode="group",
    height=500,
    legend=dict(orientation="h", yanchor="bottom", y=1.02, xanchor="right", x=1)
)
fig_clef_pub.show()
```
